name: Girlfriend And Boyfriend
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding the heart diligently, as it is the wellspring of life and actions (Proverbs 4:23). In relationships, purity of heart is crucial, for even looking with lust is equated with adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28), and committing adultery leads to destruction of the soul (Proverbs 6:32). Finding a godly spouse is described as a blessing and favor from the Lord (Proverbs 18:22), reflecting God's good plans for His people to enjoy peace and a hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11). True obedience to Christ requires aligning our actions with His teachings, not merely calling Him Lord (Luke 6:46).
